rationale: C11 is a highly plausible direct drafting template. It concerns the same Waianae-Kai Military Reservation, relies on the same chain of earlier withdrawal orders, uses nearly identical recitals and operative restoration language, and organizes the conveyed land into parcels tied to tracts described in the same 1939 directive. The child adapts that concrete framework to additional tracts and adds a retained maneuver-access right. C04 and C02 share closely related Hawaii military-land restoration forms, but neither matches the child as specifically as C11.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS certain lands at Waianae Kai, District of Waianae, Island of Oahu, Territory of Hawaii, which form a part of the public lands ceded and transferred to the United States by the Republic of Hawaii under the joint resolution of annexation of July 7, 1898, 30 Stat. 750, were withdrawn and set aside for military purposes by [the same sequence of directives]
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS certain lands at Waianae Kai, District of Waianae, Island of Oahu, Territory of Hawaii, which form a part of the public lands ceded and transferred to the United States by the Republic of Hawaii under the joint resolution of annexation of July 7, 1898, 30 Stat. 750, were withdrawn and set aside for military purposes by [the same sequence of directives]
shared_material.explanation: The opening recital is essentially the same distinctive reservation history, not merely generic Hawaii land boilerplate.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS the hereinafter-described parcels of such land are no longer fully needed for military purposes, and it is deemed advisable and in the public interest that they be restored to the possession, use, and control of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS the hereinafter-described parcels of such lands are no longer needed for military purposes, and it is deemed advisable and in the public interest that they be restored to the possession, use, and control of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.explanation: The child closely reproduces the parent's factual and public-interest recital, adding only the qualifier “fully” to accommodate the retained maneuver right.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the following-described parcels of land comprising portions of the Waianae-Kai Military Reservation, located at Waianae-Kai, District of Waianae, Island of Oahu, Territory of Hawaii, are hereby restored to the possession, use, and control of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The following-described parcels of land comprising portions of the Waianae-Kai Military Reservation located at Waianae Kai, District of Waianae, on the Island of Oahu, Territory of Hawaii, are hereby restored to the possession, use, and control of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.explanation: The operative grant is almost verbatim and applies the same administrative mechanism to later parcels of the same reservation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: PARCEL I Being the same property described as Tract No. 2 in [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of May 3, 1939. PARCEL II Being the same property described as Tract No. 3 in [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of May 3, 1939.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: PARCEL I Being a portion of the property described as Tract 7 in Presidential [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of May 3, 1939. PARCEL II Being the same property described as Tract 8 in Presidential [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of May 3, 1939.
shared_material.explanation: Both orders use a parcel-by-parcel sequence keyed to tracts in the same 1939 directive, followed by detailed metes-and-bounds descriptions.
